official.method: Visible official booking UI in Edge; selected one-way flight and expanded cart price breakdown; no passenger data, reservation or payment

flynow.conclusion: The original 0001 is an upstream search failure, not evidence of sold out. Its undocumented internal cause is not proven. Later access failures are separate observations; no proxy or challenge bypass attempted.

alternatives.name: BestPrice
alternatives.decision: Rejected: removing explicit agency fee still does not match official taxes. Read-only verification endpoint returned Not verify; no exact revalidated quote obtained.

alternatives.name: ABAY
alternatives.decision: Rejected: public search and fare-detail page omit the 181 VND precision in official taxes. Source quote age is not established.

alternatives.name: VietnamBooking
alternatives.decision: Rejected: target VNA search failed. Upstream 503 is evidence of supplier trouble, but does not prove this agency and Flynow use the same backend.

alternatives.name: TripWise
alternatives.decision: Rejected: no VNA quote returned by actual search UI or public endpoint.

alternatives.name: Goyolo
alternatives.decision: Rejected: no VNA quote returned; did not accept stale airline cache as fresh.

alternatives.name: Gotadi
alternatives.decision: Rejected: no target VNA itinerary returned.

alternatives.name: iVIVU
alternatives.decision: Rejected for unattended Worker: source requires verification token; no challenge bypass attempted.

direct_vna.decision: Blocked; no challenge bypass attempted. Calendar prices alone would also be insufficient for validating flight/fare identity.

next_requirement: A working source returning exact airline fare and taxes, verified against official flight/class/date and accessible from Workers, or authorized documented agency API access. Do not apply a fixed 181/819 VND correction, synthesize prices from rounded totals, relabel manual/browser checks as automated fetches, or overwrite last-good timestamps.
